The group is a single segment consisting only of this business, and there is no description by segment. As of the end of February 2026, the group had 669 stores: 520 of the company, 94 of Ken Depot Co., Ltd. (of which 3 are franchise stores), 34 of Home Improvement Hirose Co., Ltd., 4 of Home Center Mitsuwa Co., Ltd., and KOHNAN VIETNAM CO., LTD.17 stores. Ken Depot Co., Ltd. engages in the wholesale of building materials, and Home Improvement Hirose Co., Ltd. engages in the retail of housing-related goods and food. Products are disclosed in 5 product divisions.
